name: capital_city
description: Name the capital city of a country, few-shot. Control: same countries/format, answer is the country's continent.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
C=[('France','Paris','Europe'),('Germany','Berlin','Europe'),('Japan','Tokyo','Asia'),('China','Beijing','Asia'),('Italy','Rome','Europe'),('Spain','Madrid','Europe'),('Canada','Ottawa','North America'),('Russia','Moscow','Europe'),('Egypt','Cairo','Africa'),('Kenya','Nairobi','Africa'),('Peru','Lima','South America'),('Chile','Santiago','South America'),('Argentina','Buenos Aires','South America'),('Greece','Athens','Europe'),('Portugal','Lisbon','Europe'),('Poland','Warsaw','Europe'),('Austria','Vienna','Europe'),('Sweden','Stockholm','Europe'),('Norway','Oslo','Europe'),('Finland','Helsinki','Europe'),('Thailand','Bangkok','Asia'),('Vietnam','Hanoi','Asia'),('India','New Delhi','Asia'),('Iran','Tehran','Asia'),('Iraq','Baghdad','Asia'),('Turkey','Ankara','Asia'),('Mexico','Mexico City','North America'),('Cuba','Havana','North America'),('Australia','Canberra','Oceania'),('Ireland','Dublin','Europe'),('Hungary','Budapest','Europe'),('Denmark','Copenhagen','Europe'),('Nigeria','Abuja','Africa'),('Ethiopia','Addis Ababa','Africa'),('Colombia','Bogota','South America'),('Indonesia','Jakarta','Asia'),('Philippines','Manila','Asia'),('South Korea','Seoul','Asia'),('Belgium','Brussels','Europe'),('Netherlands','Amsterdam','Europe')]
items=[];control=[]
for _ in range(120):
    ex=random.sample(C,3)
    items.append({"prompt":"Capital city.\n"+"".join(f"{a}: {b}\n" for a,b,_ in ex[:2])+f"{ex[2][0]}:","answer":" "+ex[2][1]})
    control.append({"prompt":"Continent.\n"+"".join(f"{a}: {c}\n" for a,_,c in ex[:2])+f"{ex[2][0]}:","answer":" "+ex[2][2]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
